newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 17 to 19 bln Ffr BTANs on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 17 to 19 bln Ffr BTANs on Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 17 and 19 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on September 19, the Treasury said.
It said it would sell the 4.50 percent October 12, 1998 BTAN and the 5.50 percent October 12, 2001, the same bonds it sold at last month's auction.

In August, the Treasury sold a total of 16.273 billion francs of the two BTANs with an overall bid to cover ratio of 3.01. The average yield was 4.62 percent for the two-year BTAN and 5.63 percent for the 2001 BTAN.
